claimFromBridge(uint256,uint256,bytes).details: User burned coins on TEE-Chain, TEE-5 signed an approval.      The signature is verified against the registered teeSigner.

params.amount: Amount to claim (net, after fee was deducted on TEE-Chain).
params.signature: TEE-5's ECDSA signature (65 bytes: r + s + v).

depositForBridge(uint256).details: User must approve this contract for `amount` tokens first.      The fee is deducted from the deposit amount.      TEE-5 will verify this transaction via RPC and mint native coins.

params.amount: Total amount of tokens to deposit (including fee).

admin().notice: Admin address (can adjust fee and TEE signer).

bridgeFee().notice: Bridge fee in token units (default 0.1 tokens = 10^17).

claimFromBridge(uint256,uint256,bytes).notice: Claim tokens after bridging back from TEE-Chain.

claimable(address).notice: Get a user's claimable amount (deposited - claimed).

depositForBridge(uint256).notice: Deposit tokens to bridge to TEE-Chain.

depositNonce(address).notice: Next deposit nonce per user (monotonically increasing).

escrowedBalance().notice: Get the contract's token balance (total escrowed).

setTeeSigner(address).notice: Update the TEE signer address (key rotation).

teeSigner().notice: TEE-5's Ethereum address (ECDSA secp256k1 public key). Used to verify withdrawal approval signatures.

token().notice: The ERC20 token being bridged (1:1 with TEE-Chain native coin).

totalClaimed(address).notice: Total tokens claimed back by each user from bridging.

totalDeposited(address).notice: Total tokens deposited by each user for bridging.
